title: PRELUDE: A Benchmark Designed to Require Global Comprehension and Reasoning over Long Contexts
reasoning: The paper focuses on a benchmark for long-context understanding and narrative reasoning using literary prequels. While some of the literary works used as source material contain mythological elements or mention characters studying theology (e.g., 'Investiture of the Gods' or a character in 'The Count of Monte Cristo'), the benchmark itself does not evaluate or analyze religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems.
